fixes: Fixed Business Metrics Strip squeezing on Large/Largest display zoom by introducing adaptive 2-row LayoutBuilder.
Balanced root font scaler to allow up to 1.18x font scaling on compact screens for users with low vision.
Prevented text truncation and container overflow across all mobile screens.
highlights: Vyapar & Apple Hybrid Display Engine: Dynamic reflow adapts layouts across Small, Medium, Large, and Largest phone zoom settings.
Senior & Elder Readability Mode: Business Metrics Strip automatically switches to a spacious 2-row layout with extra large, high-contrast bold figures on large display zoom.
Zero Truncation or Ellipses: Sales, Pending, and Ready Jobs receive dedicated generous width with FittedBox auto-scaling so no figures are cut off.
Expanded Dropdowns & Responsive Controls: PDF arrangements, alignments, and swap buttons wrap and stack cleanly without container bleeding.
